item.title: Christmas concert on Dec. 14
item.description: THE Saipan Pacific Winds will conduct a Christmas concert on Dec. 14 at the ballroom of the Marianas Beach Resort, the former Hyatt Regency Hotel in Garapan. According to Atsuko Eck, band director, the concert will also include performances by the Rhythm’N Harmony, the Marianas High School Glee Club. item.title: Mellon Foundation awards $100K to Humanities Council’s Digital Archives Project
item.description: (NMHC) – The Northern Marianas Humanities Council has been awarded a $100,000 Public Knowledge Grant from the Mellon Foundation to support its Digital Archives Project. This grant will fund two positions — a Digital Archive Coordinator and a Digital Archive Specialist — with additional information about these job opportunities available at nmhcouncil.org. item.title: Expert: Tsunami threat greatest on Saipan’s west coast
item.description: New tsunami inundation maps for Saipan’s southern coastline indicate that the island’s western shores are more exposed to tsunami risk than previously believed, according to Dr. Kwok Fai Cheung, professor of ocean and resources engineering at the University of Hawaii. item.title: Mayor Camacho, faith leaders unite against crime
item.description: Photo by Bryan Manabat: Mayor “RB” Camacho met with faith leaders for a safer, stronger Saipan community Mayor Ramon “RB” Camacho recently convened local faith leaders to form a partnership focused on public safety, crime prevention, and youth engagement—a first-of-its-kind initiative in the Northern Mariana Islands. item.title: MHS sophomores to represent NMI at national moot court
item.description: Two Marianas High School sophomores will represent the Northern Mariana Islands at the national moot court competition in Washington, D.C. next spring. The national competition will be held at Georgetown University. MHS sophomores Steven Lian and Ricky Tang earned the honor by winning the 2025 CNMI Supreme Court Moot Court Competition on Friday. item.title: Governor, MPLT sign $29M loan for retirees’ pension
item.description: GOVERNOR David M. Apatang, Finance Secretary Tracy B. Norita, Marianas Public Land Trust Chairman Philip Mendiola-Long and MPLT Attorney Robert T. Torres on Friday signed a promissory note for the $29 million loan dedicated to the payment of retirees’ pension. The loan agreement was a condition set by the bicameral budget committee before it could act on the governor’s revised budget proposal appropriating $144.3 million for fiscal year 2026.
